messages:
Anya: Quick sync — proposing adding a top-level `telemetry` object to toolcall payloads to surface routing/latency tags. Need a compatibility plan + rollout notes. PTAL.

Sam: Is this required for all tools or opt-in? If absent, should runtime ignore? :thinking:

Anya: Opt-in by default. Existing callers shouldn't break — runtime will ignore unknown fields. We'll add to spec as optional.

Kai: Streaming implications? We'll be sending telemetry mid-stream in some cases (e.g., chunked tool outputs). Does that change event schema?

Anya: Good Q. Plan: only include telemetry on the initial toolcall event. No per-delta telemetry in this PR.

Sam: Can we see example payload?

Anya: ```json
{
  "type": "toolcall",
  "tool": "search",
  "args": {"q": "foo"},
  "telemetry": {"route": "low-latency", "trace_id": "abcd-1234"}
}
```

Kai: Lgtm but we should add a size limit (e.g., 1KB) and validate keys. Also add a lint rule in the schema repo.

Lucas: Will SDKs need to add helper types? I can add optional fields to the TS defs — non-breaking.

Anya: TL;DR rollout: add optional field + schema docs -> SDK patch -> canary 10% dedicated -> monitor errors/latency -> 100%.

deploy-bot: created tracking issue https://go/repo/issue/789 and linked PR https://go/repo/pull/456

Sam: Add a regression test for streaming reassembly to ensure ignoring unknown fields doesn't break tooling.

Kai: I'll review the PR later today. Add an ops metric for telemetry acceptance rate.

Anya: Thanks — requesting reviews from @Kai @Sam @Lucas. Marking this as async check-in :white_check_mark:

Sam: sgtm

Kai: :+1:
